notes: Symbol database for TIM2 reverse engineering. Offsets are file offsets into TIM2.EXE.

functions.name: physics_integrate_gravity
functions.description: Applies gravity to a single part's velocity: velocity_y += gravity_y; velocity_x += gravity_x (32-bit CWD+ADC)

functions.name: collision_detect_aabb
functions.description: AABB collision detection and resolution. Computes extents, performs AABB overlap test (4-edge check), follows connected part chain via 0x98/0x9A pointers

functions.name: collision_resolve_position
functions.description: Collision position correction: calculates overlap, divides by 2, adjusts pos_x/pos_y, updates velocity_y. Division by 4 (IDIV 4) in correction calculation.

functions.name: per_part_physics_step
functions.description: Main per-part physics function. Sets physics-active flag, checks disabled/frozen, calls gravity integration (0x5361E), calls collision detection (0x54459), re-checks if collision occurred

functions.name: main_frame_update
functions.description: Main frame update — runs 7 passes over all parts: (1) clear state, (2) per-part physics, (3) rope init, (4) rope + physics, (5) alt rope, (6) disabled cleanup, (7) special parts. Increments tick counter at [0x6873].

functions.name: aabb_compute_extents
functions.description: Computes AABB bounding box extents for a part based on position (0x22/0x24) and collision dimensions. Stores in global vars 0x63E0-0x63E6 (part1) and 0x63D0-0x63DE (part2).

functions.name: gravity_select_base
functions.description: Selects base gravity value from part category (CX = ES:[BX+0x3E]): CX<2→0x1C00, CX<6→0x1A00, CX<10→0x1800, CX<21→0x1600, CX<121→0x1400, CX<151→0x1200, else 0x1000. Returns in AX.

functions.name: terminal_velocity_clamp
functions.description: Applies terminal velocity clamping to gravity fields (0x3A/0x3C). Limits acceleration to prevent parts from moving too fast per frame.

functions.name: spatial_find_nearest_part
functions.description: Spatial search — iterates over parts (SI=1..count at 0x49AA), finds the part nearest to a given position by comparing each part's position with the target.

functions.name: collision_shape_test
functions.description: Shape-specific collision test — determines which collision test to use (AABB for rectangles, circle for balls with radius field).

functions.name: collision_extent_setup
functions.description: Sets up collision extent data for two parts before AABB comparison. Reads positions and dimensions, computes bounding boxes.

functions.name: rope_init_pass3
functions.description: Rope initialization pass 3 from frame update: checks part type 0x11(rope) or 0x6C(cable), reads PAR field at offset 0x38, stores at physics struct offset 0x3E.

functions.name: rope_physics_pass4
functions.description: Rope physics pass 4: calls rope constraint solver at lcall $0x30,$0x54F2, then calls per-part physics (0x55353). This is the main constraint enforcement pass.

functions.name: sound_dispatch_function
functions.description: Sound effect dispatch — CL=sub-function index (0x00-0x17). Handles: init driver (CL=0x00), load SX data (CL=0x01), init call (CL=0x02), NoteOn/NoteOff/Controller/ProgramChange/PitchWheel wrappers (CL=0x13-0x17).

functions.name: sound_processing_loop
functions.description: Sound processing loop — processes 16 sound channels. Reads from event queue at CS:[SI+0x16E]. For each channel, calls ADL.DRV functions: Controller, ProgramChange, PitchWheel, NoteOn. Event queue stores (event byte, data1, data2).

functions.name: adl_drv_load_data_call
functions.description: ADL.DRV LoadData call site: MOV BP, 1; CALL FAR CS:[0x01ED]. Loads SX patch data into driver buffer.

functions.name: adl_drv_note_off_call
functions.description: ADL.DRV NoteOff call site: MOV BP, 4; CALL FAR CS:[0x01ED].

functions.name: adl_drv_note_on_call
functions.description: ADL.DRV NoteOn call site: MOV BP, 5; CALL FAR CS:[0x01ED]. AX=voice/channel index.

functions.name: adl_drv_controller_call
functions.description: ADL.DRV Controller call site: MOV BP, 7; CALL FAR CS:[0x01ED].

functions.name: adl_drv_program_change_call
functions.description: ADL.DRV ProgramChange call site: MOV BP, 8; CALL FAR CS:[0x01ED].

functions.name: adl_drv_pitch_wheel_call
functions.description: ADL.DRV PitchWheel call site: MOV BP, 9; CALL FAR CS:[0x01ED].

functions.name: main_game_loop
functions.description: Main game loop: reads input, calls frame update (0x54EAB), renders with VBL wait (port 0x3DA), increments tick counter at [0x6873], loops. Runs at 60 Hz VBL-synchronized.

functions.name: interrupt_hook_setup
functions.description: Timer interrupt handler setup. Gets current interrupt vector (INT 21h AH=35h), saves old handler, sets new handler (INT 21h AH=25h) with handler stored at DS:[0x02]:DS:[0x04].

data_addrs.name: adl_drv_entry_ptr
data_addrs.description: ADL.DRV API entry point (segment:offset). Set by init function at 0x41428. Called via CALL FAR CS:[0x01ED] with BP = function index.

data_addrs.name: sx_patch_table
data_addrs.description: SX patch data far pointer table. 16 entries, each 4 bytes (segment:offset). Indexed by (event_byte & 0xF0) >> 2.

data_addrs.name: sound_event_queue
data_addrs.description: Sound event queue: [0x16E]=event_byte, [0x14E]=data1, [0x15E]=data2 for each channel 0-15. Processed by sound processing loop at 0x42200.

data_addrs.name: channel_state_struct
data_addrs.description: Per-channel sound state. 30-byte entries for 25 channels. Fields at relative offsets: [+0x02]=patch#, [+0x08~0x09]=volume/pan, [+0x17]=modulation/pitch. Used by sound dispatch functions.

data_addrs.name: current_part_ptr
data_addrs.description: Current part far pointer during collision detection. Set at start of collision_detect at 0x5446D.

data_addrs.name: part_count
data_addrs.description: Total number of moving parts in the current level. Used as loop bound in physics and spatial search functions.

data_addrs.name: tick_counter
data_addrs.description: Frame tick counter. Incremented once per frame (INCW at 0x53369) in the VBL-synchronized main game loop.

data_addrs.name: frame_loop_control
data_addrs.description: Main loop control flag. When set to 0x2000, the game loop continues. Set by the VBL-synchronized function at 0x55743.

data_addrs.name: aabb_extent_part1_x
data_addrs.description: AABB min/max X for part 1 during collision detection. Set by aabb_compute_extents (0x5428B). Compared with part2 extents at 0x63D0/0x63DC.

data_addrs.name: aabb_extent_part1_y
data_addrs.description: AABB min/max Y for part 1 during collision detection.

data_addrs.name: part_list_next
data_addrs.description: Linked list head pointer for the part iteration loop. Follows es:[bx+0x00]=next_lo, es:[bx+0x02]=next_hi for 32-bit far pointer.

structs.name: part_physics_internal
structs.description: INTERNAL physics struct (≥64 bytes, extends the 48-byte file format with runtime state)

fields.name: flags_active
fields.description: Active flags — bit 6: physics-active, bit 2: belt/rope connection

fields.name: flags_scenery
fields.description: Scenery/block flags — bit 5: disabled, bit 4: collision

fields.name: behavior
fields.description: Physics behavior / collision state / velocity_x lo

fields.name: pos_y_fixed
fields.description: Position Y (converted from fixed-point, after SAR 9)

fields.name: pos_x_fixed
fields.description: Position X (converted from fixed-point, after SAR 9)

fields.name: gravity_y
fields.description: Y-acceleration (gravity, per tick). Set from base/4

fields.name: part_category
fields.description: Part category for gravity lookup (CX input to gravity_select_base)

fields.name: connected_part_lo
fields.description: Connected part far pointer (lo), used for belt/rope following

structs.name: part_48byte_file
structs.description: 48-byte part entry in .LEV file (knt47 layout: base_40 + extra_N + tail_8)

fields.name: behavior
fields.description: Physics behavior modifier / rope segment length

fields.name: velocity_y_file
fields.description: Part of velocity in internal struct; appears as 'unknown_26' in unused level context

structs.name: channel_state_struct
structs.description: Sound channel state struct (30 bytes per entry, segment 0x43C6)

adl_drv.name: adl_drv_dispatch
adl_drv.description: ADL.DRV dispatch entry: MOV BP, CS:[0x1921+BP]; CALL [BP]; POP BP; RETF

adl_drv.name: adl_drv_jump_table
adl_drv.description: Jump table with 12 function entries: BP=0(VersionInfo), 1(LoadData), 2(Init), 4(NoteOff), 5(NoteOn), 7(Controller), 8(ProgramChange), 9(PitchWheel)

adl_drv.name: adl_drv_opl2_write
adl_drv.description: OPL2 register write: BX=register, CX=value. OUT DX,AL to port 0x388/0x389 with delays.

adl_drv.name: adl_drv_load_data
adl_drv.description: SX data load: copies data from ES:SI to CS:0x374, count from CS:0x372

adl_drv.name: adl_drv_reset
adl_drv.description: OPL2 reset — writes 0 to all registers 0x00-0xF6

adl_drv_data.name: opl2_status_port
adl_drv_data.description: OPL2 status/read port (same as addr port)

adl_drv_data.name: adlib_freq_table
adl_drv_data.description: AdLib frequency table — 48 entries × UINT16LE for notes in OPL2 frequency format

adl_drv_data.name: sx_patch_buffer
adl_drv_data.description: SX patch data buffer — game copies SX data here via LoadData
